How it works

Post. Review. Connect. Archive.

Every posting moves through the same four stages, so students always know a listing is real, current, and approved.

    Two catalogs

    Faculty looking for students. Students looking for each other.

    Catalog A

    Faculty → Student

    PIs, physician-scientists and residents recruit medical trainees to new or ongoing work.

    • Posted in job-listing format: stage, skills, perks
    • OSR approves for completeness
    • Periodic renewal email keeps listings current
    Catalog B

    Student → Student

    Students with an active, investigator-backed project expand their team to other productive students.

    • Requires at least one ongoing project with a named investigator
    • OSR reviews feasibility and publication potential
    • Archived automatically once contact is made
    Who benefits
    UMSOM

    More output, stronger match

    Optimized team formation raises research productivity and residency competitiveness.

    OSR

    Less triage, real metrics

    One official channel replaces ad-hoc email. Placements and engagement become trackable.

    Faculty

    A wider talent pool

    Reach beyond your department and word of mouth, with less effort per hire.

    Students

    Equal access

    Every opportunity, filterable by skill and interest. No more cold emails to outdated lists.

    Seldinger Research Platform · A proposal to the Office of Student ResearchPrototype v0.1 — not connected to UMID

    Open projects

    Filter by what you can actually do and how much time you have.

    Post a project

    Describe what you need the way you'd write a job listing. OSR reviews every posting before it goes live — usually within 3 business days.

    Required for student postings
    OSR reviews student postings for feasibility and publication potential. Not all submissions are accepted.
    Optional. Upload your own image or pick one below. Postings without an image show as a plain card.
    You'll get an email when it's approved or if OSR needs changes.

    What happens next

    Submitted — you're here
    OSR checks completeness (and feasibility for student postings)
    Approved → live in the catalog
    Every 90 days: one-click email to renew or archive
    Team formed → posting archived

    Write it like a job listing

    The postings that fill fastest say exactly what the trainee will do, how many hours it takes, and what they'll walk away with. Vague "help with research" postings rarely get qualified interest.

    Explore faculty

    Find a lab by name, department, or research focus, then see what they're recruiting for.
